findings.description:
Reentrancy in RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.executeWithdrawal(uint64) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#114-123):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- INftAcquisition721(w.asset).safeTransferFrom(address(this),w.recipient,w.tokenId) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#120)
	Balance read before the call:
	- b_scope_1 = _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,w.recipient,w.tokenId) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#119)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,address(this),w.tokenId) + w.quantity != a_scope_0 || _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,w.recipient,w.tokenId) != b_scope_1 + w.quantity || (w.kind == 1 && INftAcquisition721(w.asset).ownerOf(w.tokenId) != w.recipient) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#121)
		- stale variable `b_scope_1`
findings.boundary: A controller-authorized finite two-day notice fixes recipient, asset, quantity and epoch. Effects release exactly its reservation before the guarded transfer. Both asset endpoints and NFT ownership are verified, and a rejected payout reverts the notice and all custody/accounting.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.purchase(NftAcquisitionTypes.Order,bytes,uint64,uint64,uint48) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#84-104):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- t.allowance(address(this),venue) != 0 || ! t.approve(venue,total) || t.allowance(address(this),venue) != total (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#97)
	Balance read before the call:
	- oldCurrency = _balance(o.currency,address(this)) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#92)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- ! received || INftAcquisitionVenue(venue).orderState(id) != 1 || _balance(o.currency,address(this)) + total != oldCurrency || o.collection.codehash != c.runtimeHash || venue.codehash != venueHash || _nftBalance(o.collection,o.standard,o.seller,o.tokenId) + o.quantity != oldSeller || _nftBalance(o.collection,o.standard,address(this),o.tokenId) != oldHeld + o.quantity || (o.standard == 1 && INftAcquisition721(o.collection).ownerOf(o.tokenId) != address(this)) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#99-101)
		- stale variable `oldCurrency`
findings.boundary: Purchase consumes budget/order state before the immutable venue call. Guarded callbacks cannot reenter; the callback alone is insufficient. Actual currency debit, seller NFT decrement, vault increment, ownerOf, venue fill status and collection/venue runtime are required, with atomic rollback on a mismatch.

Only synthetic local source/route is executable; no actual 4663 marketplace adapter or production release is approved. 	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- INftAcquisition1155(w.asset).safeTransferFrom(address(this),w.recipient,w.tokenId,w.quantity,) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#120)
	Balance read before the call:
	- b_scope_1 = _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,w.recipient,w.tokenId) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#119)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,address(this),w.tokenId) + w.quantity != a_scope_0 || _nftBalance(w.asset,w.kind,w.recipient,w.tokenId) != b_scope_1 + w.quantity || (w.kind == 1 && INftAcquisition721(w.asset).ownerOf(w.tokenId) != w.recipient) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#121)
		- stale variable `b_scope_1`
findings.boundary: A controller-authorized finite two-day notice fixes recipient, asset, quantity and epoch. Effects release exactly its reservation before the guarded transfer. Both asset endpoints and NFT ownership are verified, and a rejected payout reverts the notice and all custody/accounting.
findings.remainingUncertainty: Finite tests and runtime hashing do not prove arbitrary dependencies safe. Only synthetic local source/route is executable; no actual 4663 marketplace adapter or production release is approved. Preserve full high gate; independently review supported account and external asset semantics before a changed release.

Reentrancy in RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.purchase(NftAcquisitionTypes.Order,bytes,uint64,uint64,uint48) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#84-104):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- INftAcquisitionVenue(venue).fill(o,signature) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#97)
	Balance read before the call:
	- oldSeller = _nftBalance(o.collection,o.standard,o.seller,o.tokenId) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#92)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- ! received || INftAcquisitionVenue(venue).orderState(id) != 1 || _balance(o.currency,address(this)) + total != oldCurrency || o.collection.codehash != c.runtimeHash || venue.codehash != venueHash || _nftBalance(o.collection,o.standard,o.seller,o.tokenId) + o.quantity != oldSeller || _nftBalance(o.collection,o.standard,address(this),o.tokenId) != oldHeld + o.quantity || (o.standard == 1 && INftAcquisition721(o.collection).ownerOf(o.tokenId) != address(this)) (nft-acquisition/src/RMTNftAcquisitionVaultV1.sol#99-101)
		- stale variable `oldSeller`

Actual currency debit, seller NFT decrement, vault increment, ownerOf, venue fill status and collection/venue runtime are required, with atomic rollback on a mismatch.

Only synthetic local source/route is executable; no actual 4663 marketplace adapter or production release is approved. Preserve full high gate; independently review supported account and external asset semantics before a changed release.

limitations: This venue is a signed all-or-nothing synthetic local listing venue, not Seaport or OpenSea. Official Robinhood marketplace support is a separate read-only research result, not evidence of an implemented adapter.
All new constructors and state-changing execution require chain31337. No production activation or contract change to 4663 is authorized.
Funding is a deliberate separately settled native/token transfer. V1/core/ledger/reclaim sources and immutable beneficiary rights are not modified or inherited.
Generic ERC1271 seller signatures, criteria/trait orders, multi-item orders, partial fills and external conduits are unsupported. Current exact ECDSA seller signatures are chain/venue/buyer bound.

Controller EOAs, exact pinned7702 designator, and strict pinnedSafeL2 1.4.1 3owner/2threshold/no module/no guard profile are admitted; actual current Safe owner approvals are required by Safe execution.
NFT custody withdrawals are typed two-day-noticed transfers to fixed recipients. There is no generic execute, NFT sweep, upgrade, LP principal or fungible buyback path.
The synthetic configurable NFT and currency fixtures deliberately model incorrect transfers and royalty changes; they are not real collection admissions or production payment assets.
Native payment recipients that forward funds during receipt fail exact endpoint-balance checks; no generic arbitrary wallet compatibility is claimed.
